items.title: Meta faces major social media addiction trial this week: What to watch
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) faces a new trial regarding social media addiction brought by 29 US attorneys general. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley comes on Opening Bid to discuss what he will be watching from the case that is starting this Tuesday, August 18.

items.title: Meta social media addiction trial, earnings from Walmart & Target: What to watch on Monday
